proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly separates the illa extension of gata: Prakrit gaïllaya, Assamese gâla, Bengali gela, Oriya gali/gelā, Bihari gel and Bhojpuri gail. These survey g-l past go forms match that extension, with ordinary agreement vowels and local vowel reduction. The Danuwar records are explicitly tagged third-person singular preterite; none is treated as a present yāti stem.
